Marks the targeted creature and nearby creatures with insect pheromones, causing them to be treated as arthropods. Affects yourself if no creature is targeted
spell.entomology_spell.swarm_aegis.guide: After a short chant, surround yourself with a protective swarm that reduces incoming damage by a flat amount plus a percentage, and summons fireflies to strike your targets when you attack
Summons a swarm of bees that attack the creature you last struck. While active, your attacks mark targets with Swarm Wrath, increasing the damage they take from your bees and swarm school spells
spell.entomology_spell.chaotic_stinger.g: Coats your swarm's stingers with chaotic venom. While active, bees you have summoned inflict poison or wither on every creature they sting
spell.entomology_spell.parasite.guide: Infects the targeted creature with an incubating parasite. The higher the spell level, the shorter the incubation. When it bursts, silverfish hatch around the target and it gains Child's Wrath, drawing all nearby insects to attack it
spell.entomology_spell.web_entangle.guid: Web strands burst from the ground and entangle the targeted creature, rooting it in place. The web has health and can be destroyed to free the target
spell.entomology_spell.bee_stinger.guide: Fires a swift bee stinger that deals swarm school damage on impact
spell.entomology_spell.bee_requiem.guide: Three kamikaze bees materialize above your head and dive through everything onto the selected target, dealing swarm school damage. Synergizes with Chaotic Stinger
spell.entomology_spell.bee_alarm.guide: Places alarm bees at fixed posts around you. They shoot bee stingers at hostile entities within 8 blocks. 1 bee at level 1, +1 per level. Lasts 15s at level 1, +7s per level. Benefits from Chaotic Stinger
spell.entomology_spell.summon_ice_spider: Summons a loyal frost spider that protects you and attacks your targets. Right-click the spider to ride it and steer it yourself. It climbs walls, pounces on enemies and web-grapples them in ice
spell.entomology_spell.summon_cockroach_: Summons a troupe of maraca-shaking cockroaches that dance around you. Their rhythm pulses regen, speed, haste and strength onto you and your allies nearby. Higher levels summon more roaches and stronger beats
spell.entomology_spell.summon_mosquito_s: Summons a swarm of crimson mosquitoes that dive-bomb targets for 20 seconds. They hunt other players first, then hostile mobs; every hit they land heals your other summons nearby. Higher levels summon more mosquitoes
spell.entomology_spell.swarm_exemption.g: Marks the targeted entity with Swarm: Attack, ordering insects to ignore Insect Kinship and friendly-fire protection and treat it as a valid target - whether it is your ally or your own summon
spell.entomology_spell.honey_courier.gui: Sends out a single peaceful bee that wanders for a short while, then flies back to you, restoring your health and mana plus a little hunger before vanishing
Coats your silverfish with a parasitic stench. While active, every silverfish you have summoned inflicts Hunger on its bite, plus a stack of Slowness
spell.entomology_spell.swarm_call.guide: Calls the swarm to guard their queen. While active, taking damage has a chance to summon bees right on top of the attacker, ready to sting back
Summons a swarm of butterflies that flies to the target and lifts them into the air, then drops them for fall damage. Not craftable on the scroll table
spell.entomology_spell.summon_butterfly_: Summons a Butterfly Princess ally who fights for you for 5 minutes, casting insect spells at your enemies. Not craftable on the scroll table
Transforms targeted insects into stronger forms: spiders and cave spiders become frost spiders; Alex's Mobs flies become crimson mosquitoes, and crimson mosquitoes become warped moscos
spell.entomology_spell.summon_shiraori.g: Summons the Spider Mother, Shiraori, who fights for you for 5 minutes. On arrival she first raises two spider nests nearby, then lays insect eggs that hatch into bugs, casts Web Entangle on nearby enemies, and summons a guardian spider every 30 seconds. Not craftable on the scroll table
entity.entomology_spell.spider_nest.desc: An attackable spider nest entity that periodically spawns spiders to defend the area
effect.entomology_spell.insect_pheromone: This entity is treated as an arthropod and takes bonus damage from Bane of Arthropods

effect.entomology_spell.queens_majesty.d: While the True Queen Crown is worn, nearby summons are empowered

effect.entomology_spell.parasite.descrip: An incubating parasite that will hatch silverfish and inflict Child's Wrath on the host when it bursts
effect.entomology_spell.child_wrath.desc: Draws the attacks of all nearby insects
